howto.what: Claude 会把 Discord 适配器复制进项目、注册到通道列表、安装固定版本的适配器包,再构建并跑注册测试;之后引导你创建 Discord 机器人、粘贴 Bot Token,并重启服务打通私信通道。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人通道时触发;在 /setup 流程中运行也可以,之后用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接线。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人通道接进项目
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: Discord 机器人收不到我的消息,帮我排查
重跑一遍 add-discord 的 Apply 步骤

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Discord adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, builds, and runs the registration test. It then walks you through bot setup and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, including during the /setup flow; afterwards wire it with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package, runs the test

say_en.text: My Discord bot is online but never sees my messages
say_en.note: Checks Message Content Intent and shared server
Every step is idempotent and safe to re-run
